objectives.text: Install a JDK 25 LTS build and Apache Maven, then confirm both with java -version and mvn -v
Tell the JDK from a JRE and explain why javac, java and Maven must each be found on the PATH
Open a Maven project in the IDE and select JDK 25 as its project SDK

minutes.basis: Intake planning budget for a core page under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (B8): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are 0 (not measured), not estimates. The planning value is the largest ceil(max(estimator P50, worst path)) measured on a course-1 page (10 minutes, agile-scrum-user-stories). The module PR measures the authored page with the frozen estimator, models the worst required path, and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15, without compressing other topics. See authoring/evidence/java-foundations/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
